title: WebAudioTV — Audiobook Streaming Platform
description: Streaming platform for audiobooks and long-form audio drama. Listeners play a three-level catalogue in a player that survives navigation and earn XP as they listen, publishers apply for a scoped workspace, and a PRO subscription unlocks downloads and early-access releases.
keyResults: 979 commits; roughly 35,000 lines across 33 routes, 24 Deno edge functions and 93 migrations
192 Row-Level Security policies over 40 tables, with roles kept in a separate user_roles table so a self-service profile edit can never grant admin

Audio never streams from a URL carrying a Supabase JWT: an HMAC token bound to (user_id, track_id, exp) is issued from an Authorization header, re-verified at the second hop, then SigV4-signed against a private Cloudflare R2 bucket
tracks.drive_file_url revoked at the column level from anon and authenticated, handed back only through a SECURITY DEFINER function that checks ownership in SQL
Non-R2 media fetches revalidate every redirect hop against an SSRF blocklist covering loopback, private ranges, link-local and cloud metadata addresses
389 tests across 39 files, including guard tests that read deployed edge-function source and assert the removed ?token= JWT parameter has not reappeared

title: SetupTTS — Cross-Platform Text-to-Speech Desktop App
description: Desktop app that converts text to MP3 using Microsoft's Neural voices — 300+ voices across 70+ languages, no API key required. Most of its code exists to make silent truncation of a long export impossible.
keyResults: 61 tracked files and roughly 10,300 LOC at version 1.5.6, with 42 tests running in CI and four verified installers produced per release
About 4,400 of those 10,300 lines exist to prevent a finished export from silently missing a chapter: chunk planning, a warm-up ramp, preflight, retry classification, staging and a coverage proof
Chunk limits tuned per writing system across 14 scripts — Han caps at 3,100 characters where Latin gets 10,500, because a CJK character is three UTF-8 bytes

Eight independent coverage checks before assembly (contiguity, gaps, overlaps, duplicate indexes, missing files, byte counts, per-chunk and source text hashes); anything short of a contiguous 0 to total raises CoverageError and preserves the staging directory
Two no_audio failures stop retrying and subdivide the request instead of re-sending it; transient errors back off 2, 4, 8 and 16 seconds
Three runtime dependencies and no ffmpeg — MP3 duration is read by a 123-line MPEG frame parser written for the purpose

title: txttranslation — BYOK Translation & Narration Workspace
description: Next.js workspace where each user supplies their own Google Cloud service-account credential. The credential is validated with a live API call before it is ever stored, encrypted at rest, and used server-side for both Cloud Translation and Cloud Text-to-Speech.
keyResults: 86 tracked files and roughly 10,100 source lines over 30 commits from March to August 2026; no test runner yet
Per-user service-account JSON encrypted with AES-256-GCM from node:crypto, with only projectId and clientEmail retained in clear for display
The only project here shipping a full security-header set including a real Content-Security-Policy — HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy on every response
PayPal subscription ids are re-fetched from PayPal server-side, checked for plan match and active status, and refused if already linked to another account
Every environment misconfiguration produces two messages side by side — a precise technical fault for the log and a plain-language instruction for the settings page
Translates up to 1,000,000 characters per request through backend-only routes; narration offers 25 Google Neural2 voices or 21 keyless Edge TTS voices
Currently deployed with ADMIN_ONLY_MODE enabled, billing disabled and access limited to a two-address allowlist

title: Dual-ISP Network Assessment & Subnet Remediation
description: Assessment of a home network running two independent routers on two separate internet plans with a Synology NAS bridging both, where both routers were configured on the same LAN subnet with the same gateway IP. Documents the discovery, the diagnosis and the remediation.
keyResults: Both routers were running 192.168.0.0/24 with the same gateway IP 192.168.0.1 — two physically separate LANs distinguishable only by router MAC address
Diagnosis required three separate scanning vantage points, because no single host could see both LANs: two machines behind Router A and one behind Router B
Mapped a dual-homed Synology DS423+ present on both LANs at 192.168.0.2 and 192.168.0.242, exposing SSH 22, HTTP 80, NetBIOS 139, HTTPS 443, SMB 445, DSM 5000/5001 and Synology Drive 6690
Remediated by moving Router B to 192.168.20.1/24 and its NAS interface to 192.168.20.2, separating the collision domains and disambiguating the gateway
Deliverables include two inventory scanners (PowerShell and macOS shell), per-machine scan output, five topology diagrams, an IEEE-style PDF report and a slide deck
Scope was limited to inventory and connectivity on an authorized private network — the tooling performs no exploits and makes no configuration changes

title: JEE Test Simulator — BYOK Exam Engine
description: Upload a JEE Main question paper and answer key as PDFs, have a vision-capable LLM of your choosing turn them into 75 structured questions, then sit the paper in a reproduction of the NTA exam portal. There is no database anywhere in the system.
keyResults: 49 tracked files and roughly 4,240 source lines across 10 commits, all landed on 2026-06-17
BYOK credential encrypted with AES-256-GCM using the user id as additional authenticated data, so a cookie lifted from one account and replayed into another fails the tag check and returns null

No database at all: sessions are JWTs, the provider key is an httpOnly cookie, the live exam is Zustand backed by sessionStorage, saved papers are localStorage, and rate-limit buckets are an in-memory Map — five environment variables and nothing to provision

Counts Private Use Area glyphs to decide a page needs rasterising (a Symbol-typeface pi extracts as U+F070, an integral as U+F0F2) and names the nine specific code points in the prompt so the model reads the image instead
Quality gate beyond schema validation: isWeakQuestion rejects plausible-but-useless parses, the route demands 25 questions per subject with at most 2 weak, and saving refuses to persist fewer than 75

Seven of the ten commits are attempts to fit vision transcription of a 75-question paper inside Vercel's 60-second function ceiling, resolved by issuing three separate per-subject requests of about 55 seconds each

title: Novelsin — Serialized Fiction Platform
description: A platform for reading and writing serialized fiction — readers follow novels chapter by chapter, authors publish and schedule them, admins moderate — built so that Postgres row-level security, not application code, is the real authorization boundary.
keyResults: 182 tracked files and roughly 20,950 source LOC over 19 tables, 72 idempotent RLS policies and 13 migrations
server-only acts as a compiler fence: importing data-access code into a Client Component is a build error rather than a runtime leak
createAdmin() is never called anywhere in the app — admin power comes from policies, not from a privileged client that bypasses RLS
XSS is designed out rather than sanitized: the rich-text component emits React children and anchors whose href is regex-constrained to http(s), and no dangerouslySetInnerHTML exists in the repo
The is_admin() helper is SECURITY DEFINER and pins search_path, avoiding both RLS recursion and search-path hijacking
Admin routes return 404 rather than 403 to non-admins, so their existence is never disclosed; roles are derived from behaviour rather than assigned through an upgrade flow

title: SplitForge Local — Browser Text Chunker
description: Paste a large text file, split it into numbered chunks under a character limit, and save them to a real folder or a ZIP — entirely in the browser, with a Web Worker doing the work and splitting that is safe across Unicode code points.
keyResults: 30 tracked files, roughly 1,615 lines of source plus 167 lines of tests; 41 tests across 3 suites pass in 0.4 seconds
Every operation runs on an array of code points rather than the raw string, so an emoji is never left as a lone surrogate across two files — asserted directly in the suite
Tests assert invariants rather than outputs: rejoined chunks equal the input across five tests including a 65,000-character case, and every chunk stays under the limit across four more

Smart mode searches backwards for a paragraph break, then a newline, then a space, but never past a 60 percent floor — without which a stray early newline produces a 40-character file and wrecks the packing
The live preview truncates its input rather than its output, so typing into a 10 MB paste stays responsive
Four runtime dependencies, no server, no database and no telemetry — nothing leaves the browser

title: ResGhost JobRadar — AI Job Discovery Pipeline
description: A single-user AI job finder: upload a resume, search five job sources plus an OpenAI web-search path in parallel, dedupe and rank the results, tailor a resume variant per job, and track which exact resume went where.
keyResults: 91 tracked files and roughly 11,150 source LOC over 17 commits, with a 4,420-line lib layer across six modules
All 18 API routes re-check authorization independently instead of trusting middleware, which has historically been bypassable in Next.js

Ranking combines nine weighted factors summing to exactly 1.00 — match 0.50, freshness 0.12, source quality 0.10, domain relevance 0.10, location 0.08, type 0.04, work mode 0.02, salary 0.02, duplicate confidence 0.02
The source-quality table scores the app's own AI web-search path at 68, below every named ATS — an honest self-assessment encoded inside the ranking function
The zero-result diagnostic reports which filter eliminated everything, with counts and samples, turning the least debuggable complaint in a search product into a one-line answer
Sources are fetched under Promise.allSettled so one dead API degrades the search rather than failing it, and the SerpAPI budget is capped in code at six calls per run
PBKDF2-SHA256 through Web Crypto at 100,000 iterations with a per-user salt; the base resume is never overwritten and each application records the variant id that was sent

title: Zelqorix Corporate Showcase — Hardened Static Site
description: Static corporate website for an AI product and software engineering company, with a frontend security-hardening pass written specifically for static hosting.
keyResults: 65 commits, with the hero and company positioning reworked in July 2026
Strict Content-Security-Policy with a static-host-compatible meta fallback, plus a generated deployment header file for hosts that support custom headers
Referrer, framing, permissions, MIME-type and cross-origin hardening headers shipped in vercel.json alongside an SPA fallback route
The external Google Fonts dependency was removed, so no third-party origin is contacted at runtime
The CSP hash dependency for JSON-LD blocks is documented, so SEO structured data does not force unsafe-inline back into the policy
Five-breakpoint responsive layout, SEO metadata with canonical, robots, sitemap and JSON-LD, and a production-safe error fallback instead of client-visible failures
